question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "venerate".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Despise.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Venerate" means to regard with deep respect or reverence. (श्रद्धा करना)
◦ Example: Many communities venerate their elders for their wisdom.

 

• "Despise" means to feel deep contempt or dislike for someone or something, and is therefore the correct antonym. (तिरस्कार करना)
◦ Example: He grew to despise the dishonesty he saw in the industry.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Revere (श्रद्धा रखना): To feel deep and reverential respect — a synonym of venerate, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Admire (प्रशंसा करना): To regard with respect and approval — a synonym of venerate, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Honor (सम्मान करना): To regard or treat with great respect — a synonym of venerate, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of venerate: revere, admire, honor, worship, esteem.

 

• Synonyms of despise: scorn, disdain, loathe, detest.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Deft (कुशल): Clumsy (अनाड़ी), Awkward (भद्दा)

2. Eloquent (वाक्पटु): Inarticulate (अस्पष्टवादी), Tongue-tied (हकलाने वाला)

3. Garrulous (बकबक करने वाला): Reticent (मितभाषी), Taciturn (चुप रहने वाला)

4. Hapless (अभागा): Fortunate (भाग्यशाली), Lucky (सौभाग्यशाली)

5. Indolent (आलसी): Diligent (मेहनती), Industrious (परिश्रमी)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Fastidious."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Sloppy.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Fastidious" means very attentive to and concerned about accuracy and detail; hard to please. (दोषान्वेषी)

 

• "Sloppy" means careless and lacking neatness or precision, and practically the opposite of someone who fusses over every detail. It is therefore the correct antonym. (लापरवाह)
◦ Example: His sloppy handwriting made the notes hard to read.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Meticulous (बारीकी से काम करने वाला) — showing great attention to detail; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Particular (चूजी) — demanding in one's requirements; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Finicky (नकचढ़ा) — excessively fussy about details; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of fastidious: sloppy, careless, easygoing, undemanding.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Judicious (विवेकपूर्ण): Foolish (मूर्खतापूर्ण), Imprudent (अविवेकी)

2. Languid (सुस्त): Energetic (ऊर्जावान), Lively (जीवंत)

3. Meager (अल्प): Abundant (प्रचुर), Ample (पर्याप्त)

4. Nonchalant (उदासीन): Anxious (चिंतित), Concerned (फ़िक्रमंद)

5. Opulent (समृद्ध): Poor (गरीब), Impoverished (दरिद्र)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "sporadic".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Frequent.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Sporadic" means occurring at irregular intervals; scattered or isolated. (छिटपुट)
◦ Example: There were only sporadic showers throughout the dry month.

 

• "Frequent" means occurring often or at short intervals, and is therefore the correct antonym. (बार-बार होने वाला)
◦ Example: Frequent power cuts disrupted work all week.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Occasional (कभी-कभार): Occurring infrequently or irregularly — a synonym of sporadic, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Intermittent (रुक-रुक कर होने वाला): Occurring at irregular intervals; not continuous — a synonym of sporadic, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Irregular (अनियमित): Not even or uniform; without a fixed pattern — a synonym of sporadic, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of sporadic: occasional, intermittent, irregular, scattered.

 

• Synonyms of frequent: recurrent, regular, common, repeated.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Pragmatic (व्यावहारिक): Idealistic (आदर्शवादी), Impractical (अव्यावहारिक)

2. Reticent (मितभाषी): Talkative (बातूनी), Outspoken (स्पष्टवादी)

3. Staunch (दृढ़): Disloyal (बेवफा), Unfaithful (विश्वासघाती)

4. Tranquil (शांत): Turbulent (अशांत), Chaotic (अराजक)

5. Unwavering (अटल): Hesitant (हिचकिचाने वाला), Wavering (डगमगाने वाला)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Felicitous."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Unfortunate.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Felicitous" means well-chosen, apt, or pleasingly appropriate; also fortunate. (सुखद)

 

• "Unfortunate" means having bad luck, or inappropriate and regrettable, and practically the opposite of a happily apt remark or outcome. It is therefore the correct antonym. (दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण)
◦ Example: It was an unfortunate choice of words at such a solemn moment.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Apt (उपयुक्त) — suitable or appropriate in the circumstances; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Fitting (उचित) — appropriate to the situation; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Fortunate (सौभाग्यशाली) — favoured by luck; a synonym in this sense, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of felicitous: unfortunate, inappropriate, unsuitable, awkward.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Vigilant (सतर्क): Careless (लापरवाह), Negligent (उपेक्षापूर्ण)

2. Wistful (तड़पता हुआ): Content (संतुष्ट), Cheerful (प्रसन्न)

3. Austere (सादा): Luxurious (विलासी), Extravagant (फिजूलखर्च)

4. Brazen (ढीठ): Timid (डरपोक), Shy (शर्मीला)

5. Cryptic (रहस्यमय): Clear (स्पष्ट), Obvious (प्रत्यक्ष)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "tacit".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Explicit.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Tacit" means understood or implied without being directly stated. (मौन)
◦ Example: Her silence was taken as tacit approval of the plan.

 

• "Explicit" means stated clearly and in detail, leaving nothing implied, and is therefore the correct antonym. (स्पष्ट)
◦ Example: The manager gave explicit instructions on how to handle the complaint.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Implied (निहित): Suggested without being directly stated — a synonym of tacit, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Unspoken (अनकहा): Not expressed in words though understood — a synonym of tacit, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Implicit (अंतर्निहित): Implied though not plainly expressed — a synonym of tacit, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of tacit: implied, unspoken, implicit, understood.

 

• Synonyms of explicit: clear, direct, plain, unambiguous.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Dour (कठोर): Cheerful (प्रसन्न), Genial (मिलनसार)

2. Frivolous (तुच्छ): Serious (गंभीर), Sensible (समझदार)

3. Grim (गंभीर): Cheerful (प्रसन्न), Pleasant (सुखद)

4. Haughty (घमंडी): Humble (विनम्र), Modest (सामान्य)

5. Impetuous (उतावला): Cautious (सतर्क), Deliberate (विचारशील)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Esoteric."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Common.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Esoteric" means intended for or understood by only a small group with specialized knowledge; obscure. (गूढ़)

 

• "Common" means found or occurring often; ordinary and widely known, and practically the opposite of specialized knowledge meant for a select few. It is therefore the correct antonym. (सामान्य)
◦ Example: Using a smartphone has become a common skill for people of all ages.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Obscure (अस्पष्ट) — not discovered or known about; understood by few; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Abstruse (दुर्बोध) — difficult to understand; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Arcane (रहस्यमय) — understood by only a few with specialized knowledge; a synonym, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of esoteric: common, general, widespread, mainstream.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Jocund (हंसमुख): Melancholy (उदास), Gloomy (गमगीन)

2. Listless (सुस्त): Energetic (ऊर्जावान), Enthusiastic (उत्साही)

3. Effusive (भावुकतापूर्ण): Reserved (संकोची), Restrained (संयमित)

4. Insipid (नीरस): Flavorful (स्वादिष्ट), Interesting (रोचक)

5. Munificent (दानशील): Stingy (कंजूस), Miserly (कृपण)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "innocuous".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Harmful.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Innocuous" means harmless and not likely to cause offence or harm. (हानिरहित)
◦ Example: The committee found the joke innocuous and let it pass without comment.

 

• "Harmful" means causing damage or injury, and is therefore the correct antonym. (हानिकारक)
◦ Example: Excessive exposure to the sun can be harmful to the skin.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Harmless (हानिरहित): Means causing no harm — a synonym of innocuous, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Benign (सौम्य): Means gentle and not harmful — a synonym of innocuous, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Innocent (निर्दोष): Means free from guilt or harm — closely related to innocuous in meaning, not its antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of innocuous: harmless, benign, safe, inoffensive, innocent.

 

• Synonyms of harmful: damaging, injurious, detrimental, hurtful, noxious.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Sporadic (अनियमित): Frequent (बार-बार), Regular (नियमित)

2. Diligent (मेहनती): Lazy (आलसी), Idle (निष्क्रिय)

3. Benevolent (परोपकारी): Malevolent (द्वेषपूर्ण), Cruel (क्रूर)

4. Frugal (मितव्ययी): Extravagant (फिजूलखर्च), Wasteful (अपव्ययी)

5. Obstinate (जिद्दी): Flexible (लचीला), Compliant (आज्ञाकारी)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Profuse."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Scarce.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Profuse" means plentiful or abundant in quantity. (प्रचुर)

 

• "Scarce" means insufficient in quantity; not enough to meet demand, and practically indicating a lack of abundance. It is therefore the correct antonym. (दुर्लभ)
◦ Example: Clean drinking water is scarce in many drought-affected regions.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Abundant (प्रचुर) — existing in large quantities; a synonym of profuse, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Copious (प्रचुर मात्रा में) — abundant in supply or quantity; a synonym of profuse.

 

• Option 4: Plentiful (भरपूर) — existing in great quantity; a synonym of profuse, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of profuse: meager, sparse, insufficient, limited, scanty.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Candid (स्पष्टवादी): Deceptive (छलपूर्ण), Evasive (टालमटोल करने वाला)

2. Meticulous (बारीकी से ध्यान देने वाला): Careless (लापरवाह), Sloppy (गंदा)

3. Voracious (अत्यधिक भूखा): Moderate (संयमित), Abstemious (संयमी)

4. Lucid (स्पष्ट): Confusing (भ्रमित करने वाला), Obscure (अस्पष्ट)

5. Amiable (मिलनसार): Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण), Unfriendly (अमैत्रीपूर्ण)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "garrulous".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Quiet.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Garrulous" means excessively talkative, especially about trivial matters. (बातूनी)
◦ Example: The garrulous old man kept the entire bus stop entertained with his endless stories.

 

• "Quiet" means making little or no noise; reserved in speech, and is therefore the correct antonym. (शांत)
◦ Example: She remained quiet throughout the meeting, speaking only when asked a direct question.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Talkative (बातूनी): Means fond of talking a great deal — a synonym of garrulous, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Chatty (गपशप करने वाला): Means talking in a light, friendly way — a synonym of garrulous, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Verbose (शब्दाडंबरपूर्ण): Means using more words than needed — closely related to garrulous, not its antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of garrulous: talkative, chatty, loquacious, voluble, wordy.

 

• Synonyms of quiet: silent, reserved, taciturn, reticent, still.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Prudent (विवेकपूर्ण): Reckless (लापरवाह), Careless (असावधान)

2. Taciturn (कम बोलने वाला): Talkative (बातूनी), Loquacious (वाचाल)

3. Zealous (उत्साही): Apathetic (उदासीन), Indifferent (बेपरवाह)

4. Austere (सादगीपूर्ण): Luxurious (विलासितापूर्ण), Lavish (भव्य)

5. Candor (स्पष्टवादिता): Deceit (छल), Duplicity (दोहरापन)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Futile."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Effective.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Futile" means completely ineffective or pointless, producing no useful result. (व्यर्थ)

 

• "Effective" means producing the intended or desired result, and practically indicating that an action achieves its purpose. It is therefore the correct antonym. (प्रभावी)
◦ Example: The new marketing strategy proved effective, doubling the company's sales within a year.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Useless (बेकार) — having no practical use; a synonym of futile.

 

• Option 2: Vain (व्यर्थ) — producing no result despite effort; a synonym of futile in this sense.

 

• Option 3: Fruitless (निष्फल) — failing to achieve the desired outcome; a synonym of futile.

 

• Other antonyms of futile: useful, productive, worthwhile, successful, fruitful.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Docile (आज्ञाकारी): Unruly (अनियंत्रित), Rebellious (विद्रोही)

2. Enigmatic (रहस्यमय): Clear (स्पष्ट), Obvious (सुस्पष्ट)

3. Fastidious (अत्यधिक चूज़ी): Careless (लापरवाह), Undemanding (कम मांग वाला)

4. Gullible (भोला): Skeptical (संदेहशील), Suspicious (शंकाशील)

5. Humble (विनम्र): Arrogant (घमंडी), Proud (अभिमानी)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "connive".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Oppose.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Connive" means to secretly cooperate or conspire in order to do something illegal or wrong. (मिलीभगत करना)
◦ Example: The manager was accused of conniving with suppliers to inflate invoice prices.

 

• "Oppose" means to actively resist or disagree with something, and is therefore the correct antonym. (विरोध करना)
◦ Example: Several senators openly opposed the controversial bill before it was passed.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Conspire (षड्यंत्र रचना): Means to plan secretly with others to do something wrong — a synonym of connive, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Collude (मिलीभगत करना): Means to cooperate secretly for a deceitful purpose — a synonym of connive.

 

• Option 4: Scheme (साज़िश करना): Means to make secret and often underhanded plans — a synonym of connive, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of connive: conspire, collude, scheme, plot, collaborate secretly.

 

• Synonyms of oppose: resist, contest, defy, challenge, combat.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Impetuous (उतावला): Cautious (सतर्क), Deliberate (सोच-समझकर किया गया)

2. Jubilant (अत्यंत प्रसन्न): Sad (दुखी), Dejected (निराश)

3. Keen (उत्सुक): Indifferent (उदासीन), Apathetic (निरुत्साही)

4. Lethargic (सुस्त): Energetic (ऊर्जावान), Active (सक्रिय)

5. Malign (निंदा करना): Praise (प्रशंसा करना), Commend (सराहना करना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Ponderous."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Light.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Ponderous" means extremely heavy, slow, and clumsy due to weight, or labored and dull in style. (भारी-भरकम)

 

• "Light" means having little weight; easy to carry or move, and practically indicating agility and ease of movement. It is therefore the correct antonym. (हल्का)
◦ Example: The dancers moved with light, graceful steps across the stage.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Heavy (भारी) — of great weight; a synonym of ponderous.

 

• Option 3: Cumbersome (बोझिल) — awkward to carry or move because of size or weight; a synonym of ponderous.

 

• Option 4: Weighty (वज़नी) — heavy or burdensome; a synonym of ponderous, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of ponderous: nimble, agile, light-footed, graceful, brisk.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Nurture (पालन-पोषण करना): Neglect (उपेक्षा करना), Abandon (त्याग देना)

2. Obscure (अस्पष्ट): Clear (स्पष्ट), Famous (प्रसिद्ध)

3. Placid (शांत): Turbulent (अशांत), Agitated (विक्षुब्ध)

4. Quaint (आकर्षक पुरातन ढंग का): Modern (आधुनिक), Ordinary (सामान्य)

5. Rigid (कठोर): Flexible (लचीला), Pliable (नमनीय)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "gregarious".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Solitary.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Gregarious" means fond of company; sociable and outgoing. (मिलनसार)
◦ Example: Being naturally gregarious, she made friends within minutes of joining the new office.

 

• "Solitary" means preferring to be alone; avoiding the company of others, and is therefore the correct antonym. (एकांतप्रिय)
◦ Example: After retirement, he led a solitary life in a small cottage in the hills.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Sociable (मिलनसार): Means fond of companionship and friendly — a synonym of gregarious, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Outgoing (खुलेदिल): Means friendly and socially confident — a synonym of gregarious.

 

• Option 4: Convivial (उल्लासपूर्ण): Means friendly and lively in a social setting — a synonym of gregarious, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of gregarious: sociable, outgoing, convivial, companionable, social.

 

• Synonyms of solitary: reclusive, secluded, lonely, isolated, unsociable.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Somber (उदास): Cheerful (प्रफुल्लित), Bright (उज्ज्वल)

2. Tranquil (शांत): Chaotic (अराजक), Turbulent (अशांत)

3. Ubiquitous (सर्वव्यापी): Rare (दुर्लभ), Scarce (कम)

4. Vivacious (जीवंत): Dull (नीरस), Lifeless (निर्जीव)

5. Wary (सतर्क): Trusting (भरोसा करने वाला), Careless (लापरवाह)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Upright."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Corrupt.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Upright" means strictly honest and morally correct in conduct. (ईमानदार)

 

• "Corrupt" means willing to act dishonestly for personal gain, and practically indicating a lack of moral integrity. It is therefore the correct antonym. (भ्रष्ट)
◦ Example: The investigation exposed several corrupt officials who had accepted bribes for years.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Honest (ईमानदार) — free of deceit; a synonym of upright.

 

• Option 2: Righteous (नेक) — morally right and justifiable; a synonym of upright.

 

• Option 3: Ethical (नैतिक) — conforming to accepted moral principles; a synonym of upright, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of upright: dishonest, unscrupulous, crooked, immoral, unethical.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Yield (झुक जाना): Resist (विरोध करना), Withstand (झेलना)

2. Coherent (सुसंगत): Confusing (भ्रमित करने वाला), Incoherent (असंगत)

3. Deft (निपुण): Clumsy (अनाड़ी), Awkward (भद्दा)

4. Eloquent (वाकपटु): Inarticulate (अस्पष्ट वक्ता), Tongue-tied (बोलने में असमर्थ)

5. Flimsy (भंगुर): Sturdy (मज़बूत), Robust (दृढ़)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "iconoclast".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Conformist.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Iconoclast" means a person who attacks or challenges cherished beliefs, traditions, or institutions. (परंपरा भंजक)
◦ Example: The young artist was seen as an iconoclast for rejecting every convention of classical painting.

 

• "Conformist" means a person who conforms to accepted behavior or established beliefs, and is therefore the correct antonym. (परंपरावादी)
◦ Example: As a lifelong conformist, he never questioned the rules laid down by his family.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Rebel (विद्रोही): Means a person who resists authority or convention — a synonym of iconoclast, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Nonconformist (गैर-परंपरावादी): Means one who does not conform to accepted beliefs — a synonym of iconoclast.

 

• Option 4: Maverick (स्वतंत्र विचारक): Means an unorthodox or independent-minded person — a synonym of iconoclast, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of iconoclast: rebel, nonconformist, maverick, dissenter, radical.

 

• Synonyms of conformist: traditionalist, conventionalist, follower, loyalist.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Genuine (असली): Fake (नकली), Counterfeit (जाली)

2. Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण): Friendly (मित्रतापूर्ण), Amicable (सौहार्दपूर्ण)

3. Impartial (निष्पक्ष): Biased (पक्षपाती), Partial (पक्षपातपूर्ण)

4. Jovial (हंसमुख): Gloomy (उदास), Morose (खिन्न)

5. Kindle (प्रज्वलित करना): Extinguish (बुझाना), Douse (बुझा देना)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Ignorance."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Knowledge.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Ignorance" means lack of knowledge, information, or awareness about something. (अज्ञानता)

 

• "Knowledge" means facts, information, and understanding acquired through experience or education, and practically indicating awareness of the truth. It is therefore the correct antonym. (ज्ञान)
◦ Example: Her deep knowledge of maritime law impressed every member of the tribunal.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Unawareness (अनभिज्ञता) — lack of awareness of a fact or situation; a synonym of ignorance.

 

• Option 3: Incomprehension (समझ की कमी) — inability to understand; a synonym of ignorance in effect.

 

• Option 4: Unfamiliarity (अपरिचय) — lack of familiarity or knowledge of something; a synonym of ignorance, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of ignorance: awareness, understanding, wisdom, learning, enlightenment.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Languid (शिथिल): Energetic (ऊर्जावान), Vigorous (जोरदार)

2. Meager (अपर्याप्त): Abundant (प्रचुर), Plentiful (भरपूर)

3. Naive (भोला-भाला): Sophisticated (परिष्कृत), Worldly (सांसारिक अनुभव वाला)

4. Opulent (वैभवशाली): Poor (गरीब), Impoverished (निर्धन)

5. Pragmatic (व्यावहारिक): Idealistic (आदर्शवादी), Impractical (अव्यावहारिक)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "ineffable".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Expressible.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Ineffable" means too great, intense, or sacred to be expressed or described in words. (अवर्णनीय)
◦ Example: Watching the sunrise from the mountain peak filled her with an ineffable sense of peace.

 

• "Expressible" means capable of being expressed or put into words, and is therefore the correct antonym. (व्यक्त करने योग्य)
◦ Example: Unlike his earlier confusion, his gratitude was easily expressible in a short, heartfelt note.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Indescribable (अवर्णनीय): Means too extreme to be described in words — a synonym of ineffable, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Inexpressible (अकथनीय): Means unable to be expressed in words — a synonym of ineffable.

 

• Option 4: Unutterable (अकथनीय): Means too great to be spoken about — a synonym of ineffable, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of ineffable: indescribable, inexpressible, unutterable, indefinable, unspeakable.

 

• Synonyms of expressible: sayable, statable, describable, communicable.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Quell (दबाना): Incite (भड़काना), Provoke (उकसाना)

2. Robust (सशक्त): Weak (कमज़ोर), Frail (दुर्बल)

3. Stern (सख्त): Lenient (नरम), Gentle (कोमल)

4. Timid (डरपोक): Bold (साहसी), Fearless (निडर)

5. Unruly (उद्दंड): Obedient (आज्ञाकारी), Disciplined (अनुशासित)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Credulous."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Skeptical.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Credulous" means having or showing too great a readiness to believe things; easily deceived. (जल्दी विश्वास करने वाला)

 

• "Skeptical" means having doubts or reservations about the truth of a claim, and practically indicating a habit of questioning rather than accepting readily. It is therefore the correct antonym. (संदेहशील)
◦ Example: The auditors remained skeptical of the company's figures until every entry was verified.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Gullible (भोला) — easily deceived or tricked; a synonym of credulous.

 

• Option 2: Trusting (भरोसा करने वाला) — inclined to believe others readily; a synonym of credulous in this sense.

 

• Option 3: Naive (भोला-भाला) — showing a lack of experience or judgment; a synonym of credulous, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of credulous: doubtful, distrustful, incredulous, suspicious, wary.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Vigilant (सतर्क): Careless (लापरवाह), Negligent (उपेक्षापूर्ण)

2. Wane (क्षीण होना): Wax (बढ़ना), Grow (बढ़ना)

3. Ambiguous (द्विअर्थी): Clear (स्पष्ट), Unambiguous (असंदिग्ध)

4. Blunt (कुंद): Sharp (तेज़), Tactful (व्यवहारकुशल)

5. Yearn (तड़पना): Dislike (नापसंद करना), Loathe (घृणा करना)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "repudiate".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Accept.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Repudiate" means to refuse to accept, recognize, or be associated with something; to reject as untrue or invalid. (अस्वीकार करना)
◦ Example: The minister repudiated the allegations of corruption as baseless and politically motivated.

 

• "Accept" means to consent to receive or agree with something, and is therefore the correct antonym. (स्वीकार करना)
◦ Example: After much deliberation, the board decided to accept the merger proposal.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Reject (अस्वीकार करना): Means to refuse to accept or consider — a synonym of repudiate, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Renounce (त्याग देना): Means to formally give up a claim, right, or belief — a synonym of repudiate.

 

• Option 4: Disown (नकार देना): Means to refuse to acknowledge as one's own — a synonym of repudiate, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of repudiate: reject, renounce, disown, disavow, deny.

 

• Synonyms of accept: agree, acknowledge, embrace, approve, consent.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Vivid (जीवंत): Dull (फीका), Bland (नीरस)

2. Turbulent (अशांत): Calm (शांत), Peaceful (शांतिपूर्ण)

3. Sagacious (बुद्धिमान): Foolish (मूर्ख), Unwise (नासमझ)

4. Reticent (अल्पभाषी): Talkative (बातूनी), Voluble (वाचाल)

5. Perilous (खतरनाक): Safe (सुरक्षित), Secure (सुरक्षित)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Felicity."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Misery.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Felicity" means intense happiness or bliss. (परम सुख/आनंद)

 

• "Misery" means great unhappiness, distress, or suffering, and figuratively a state of deep wretchedness. It is therefore the correct antonym. (दुख/कष्ट)
◦ Example: The refugees endured years of misery before finding a safe home.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Bliss (परम आनंद) — a synonym of felicity, denoting perfect happiness, not its opposite.

 

• Option 3: Delight (आनंद/हर्ष) — a synonym describing great pleasure, not an antonym of felicity.

 

• Option 4: Ecstasy (अत्यानंद/उन्माद) — a synonym for intense joy or rapture, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of felicity: sorrow, distress, wretchedness, affliction, anguish.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Diligent (मेहनती/परिश्रमी): Lazy (आलसी), Indolent (सुस्त)

2. Benevolent (दयालु/परोपकारी): Malevolent (द्वेषपूर्ण), Cruel (क्रूर)

3. Candid (स्पष्टवादी/निष्कपट): Deceptive (छलपूर्ण), Evasive (टालमटोल करने वाला)

4. Frugal (मितव्ययी): Extravagant (फिजूलखर्च), Wasteful (अपव्ययी)

5. Meticulous (सूक्ष्म/सावधान): Careless (लापरवाह), Sloppy (लापरवाह/गंदा)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "sagacious".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Foolish.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Sagacious" means wise and showing keen judgment or discernment. (बुद्धिमान/समझदार)
◦ Example: The sagacious old teacher always gave advice that proved right in the end.

 

• "Foolish" means lacking good sense or judgment, and is therefore the correct antonym. (मूर्खतापूर्ण)
◦ Example: It was foolish of him to invest his entire savings without any research.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Astute (चतुर/तीक्ष्णबुद्धि): Having sharp judgment — a synonym of sagacious, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Shrewd (चालाक/व्यवहारकुशल): Having practical cleverness — a synonym of sagacious, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Judicious (विवेकपूर्ण): Showing sound judgment — a synonym of sagacious, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of sagacious: wise, shrewd, astute, judicious, perceptive.

 

• Synonyms of foolish: silly, unwise, senseless, imprudent, stupid.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Obstinate (जिद्दी): Flexible (लचीला), Compliant (अनुपालक/आज्ञाकारी)

2. Verbose (शब्दाडंबरपूर्ण): Concise (संक्षिप्त), Terse (संक्षिप्त/रूखा)

3. Timid (डरपोक): Bold (साहसी), Courageous (साहसी)

4. Genuine (असली/वास्तविक): Fake (नकली), Counterfeit (जाली)

5. Ephemeral (अल्पकालिक): Permanent (स्थायी), Enduring (चिरस्थायी)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Serene."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Chaotic.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Serene" means calm, peaceful, and untroubled. (शांत/निर्मल)

 

• "Chaotic" means in a state of complete disorder and confusion, and figuratively describes a scene of utter turmoil. It is therefore the correct antonym. (अव्यवस्थित/अराजक)
◦ Example: The market descended into chaotic scenes after the sudden announcement of the price hike.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Tranquil (शांत) — a synonym describing a peaceful, quiet state, not an antonym of serene.

 

• Option 2: Placid (शांत/स्थिर) — a synonym meaning calm and undisturbed, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Composed (संयत/शांतचित्त) — a synonym meaning calm and self-controlled, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of serene: turbulent, agitated, stormy, tumultuous, disturbed.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Lucid (स्पष्ट): Confusing (भ्रामक), Obscure (अस्पष्ट)

2. Ample (पर्याप्त/प्रचुर): Scanty (अपर्याप्त/कम), Insufficient (अपर्याप्त)

3. Arrogant (घमंडी): Humble (विनम्र), Modest (विनम्र/सादा)

4. Bleak (निराशाजनक): Cheerful (प्रफुल्लित), Promising (आशाजनक)

5. Coherent (सुसंगत): Incoherent (असंगत), Disjointed (असंबद्ध)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "pernicious".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Beneficial.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Pernicious" means having a harmful effect, especially in a gradual or subtle way. (हानिकारक/विनाशकारी)
◦ Example: Excessive screen time can have a pernicious effect on a child's eyesight and attention span.

 

• "Beneficial" means producing good results; advantageous, and is therefore the correct antonym. (लाभदायक/हितकारी)
◦ Example: Regular exercise is beneficial for both physical and mental health.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Harmful (हानिकारक): Causing damage — a synonym of pernicious, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Destructive (विनाशकारी): Causing great damage — a synonym of pernicious, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Injurious (हानिकारक/नुकसानदेह): Causing injury or harm — a synonym of pernicious, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of pernicious: harmful, damaging, injurious, destructive, deleterious.

 

• Synonyms of beneficial: advantageous, favorable, helpful, salutary, useful.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Eloquent (वाकपटु): Inarticulate (अस्पष्टवक्ता), Awkward (अटपटा)

2. Frivolous (तुच्छ/उथला): Serious (गंभीर), Sensible (समझदार)

3. Gregarious (मिलनसार): Reserved (अंतर्मुखी/संकोची), Solitary (एकांतप्रिय)

4. Hostile (शत्रुतापूर्ण): Friendly (मैत्रीपूर्ण), Amicable (मैत्रीपूर्ण)

5. Impartial (निष्पक्ष): Biased (पक्षपाती), Prejudiced (पूर्वाग्रही)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Noxious."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Beneficial.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Noxious" means harmful, poisonous, or very unpleasant, especially to health. (विषैला/हानिकारक)

 

• "Beneficial" means producing good results, and figuratively promotes health or well-being rather than damaging it. It is therefore the correct antonym. (लाभदायक/हितकारी)
◦ Example: Fresh air and sunlight are beneficial for a person's overall well-being.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Toxic (विषैला) — a synonym meaning poisonous or harmful, not an antonym of noxious.

 

• Option 3: Poisonous (जहरीला) — a synonym describing something capable of causing illness or death, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Harmful (हानिकारक) — a synonym meaning likely to cause damage, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of noxious: harmless, wholesome, salubrious, healthy, safe.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Jubilant (अत्यंत हर्षित): Sorrowful (दुखी), Despondent (निराश)

2. Lethargic (सुस्त): Energetic (ऊर्जावान), Active (सक्रिय)

3. Malicious (द्वेषपूर्ण): Kind (दयालु), Benevolent (परोपकारी)

4. Opulent (समृद्ध/वैभवशाली): Poor (गरीब), Impoverished (निर्धन)

5. Quaint (विचित्र पर आकर्षक/पुराने ढंग का): Modern (आधुनिक), Commonplace (सामान्य)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "disparate".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Similar.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Disparate" means essentially different in kind; too unlike to be compared. (भिन्न/असमान)
◦ Example: The committee struggled to merge the disparate opinions of its members into one policy.

 

• "Similar" means resembling something without being identical, and is therefore the correct antonym. (समान/सदृश)
◦ Example: The two proposals were similar enough to be combined into a single plan.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Dissimilar (असमान): Not alike — a synonym of disparate, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Distinct (अलग/भिन्न): Clearly different — a synonym of disparate, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Unlike (असमान): Different from — a synonym of disparate, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of disparate: different, dissimilar, distinct, unlike, contrasting.

 

• Synonyms of similar: alike, comparable, akin, resembling, analogous.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Reticent (मितभाषी): Talkative (बातूनी), Outspoken (स्पष्टवादी)

2. Stringent (कठोर): Lenient (नरम/उदार), Lax (ढीला)

3. Tedious (उबाऊ): Interesting (रोचक), Exciting (रोमांचक)

4. Vivacious (जीवंत/उत्साही): Dull (नीरस), Lethargic (सुस्त)

5. Wary (सतर्क): Careless (लापरवाह), Trusting (भरोसा करने वाला)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Pernicious."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Beneficial.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Pernicious" means having a harmful effect, often in a slow and subtle way. (हानिकारक/विनाशकारी)

 

• "Beneficial" means producing good or favorable results, and figuratively works to a person's or a society's advantage rather than eroding it. It is therefore the correct antonym. (लाभदायक/हितकारी)
◦ Example: A balanced diet has a beneficial impact on a person's long-term health.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Damaging (नुकसानदायक) — a synonym meaning causing harm, not an antonym of pernicious.

 

• Option 2: Deleterious (हानिकारक) — a formal synonym meaning harmful, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Injurious (हानिकारक/नुकसानदेह) — a synonym meaning causing injury, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of pernicious: helpful, wholesome, salutary, advantageous, favorable.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Zealous (उत्साही): Apathetic (उदासीन), Indifferent (उदासीन)

2. Abundant (प्रचुर): Scarce (दुर्लभ), Sparse (विरल)

3. Brittle (भंगुर): Flexible (लचीला), Elastic (लचीला)

4. Callous (निर्दयी/असंवेदनशील): Compassionate (दयालु), Sensitive (संवेदनशील)

5. Deft (निपुण): Clumsy (अनाड़ी), Awkward (अटपटा)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "noxious".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Beneficial.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Noxious" means harmful or poisonous, especially to health. (विषैला/हानिकारक)
◦ Example: The factory released noxious fumes that irritated the eyes of nearby residents.

 

• "Beneficial" means advantageous or producing good results, and is therefore the correct antonym. (लाभदायक/हितकारी)
◦ Example: Drinking enough water daily is beneficial for digestion.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Poisonous (जहरीला): Capable of causing illness or death — a synonym of noxious, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Injurious (हानिकारक/नुकसानदेह): Causing harm or injury — a synonym of noxious, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Noisome (दुर्गंधयुक्त/हानिकारक): Foul-smelling and harmful — a synonym of noxious, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of noxious: poisonous, toxic, harmful, injurious, noisome.

 

• Synonyms of beneficial: advantageous, helpful, wholesome, salutary, favorable.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Elusive (मायावी/पकड़ में न आने वाला): Obvious (स्पष्ट), Apparent (स्पष्ट)

3. Grave (गंभीर): Trivial (तुच्छ), Light-hearted (हल्के-फुल्के मिजाज का)

5. Impetuous (उतावला): Cautious (सतर्क), Deliberate (सोच-समझकर किया गया)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Serene."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Chaotic.

• "Serene" means calm, peaceful, and free from disturbance. (शांत/निर्मल)

 

• "Chaotic" means in a state of total disorder and confusion, and figuratively describes a scene of turmoil rather than calm. It is therefore the correct antonym. (अव्यवस्थित/अराजक)
◦ Example: Traffic turned chaotic after the signal stopped working during peak hours.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Calm (शांत) — a synonym meaning free from disturbance, not an antonym of serene.

 

• Option 3: Peaceful (शांतिपूर्ण) — a synonym meaning tranquil and undisturbed, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Placid (शांत/स्थिर) — a synonym meaning calm and untroubled, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of serene: turbulent, stormy, agitated, tumultuous, disturbed.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Judicious (विवेकपूर्ण): Reckless (लापरवाह), Rash (जल्दबाज़)

2. Keen (उत्सुक): Indifferent (उदासीन), Apathetic (उदासीन)

3. Languid (शिथिल/सुस्त): Energetic (ऊर्जावान), Vigorous (जोरदार)

5. Nimble (फुर्तीला): Clumsy (अनाड़ी), Sluggish (सुस्त)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "sagacious".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. Foolish.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Sagacious" means showing keen judgment and wisdom, especially in practical matters. (बुद्धिमान/समझदार)
◦ Example: The company's founder was known for his sagacious decisions during times of crisis.

 

• "Foolish" means lacking good sense or judgment, and is therefore the correct antonym. (मूर्खतापूर्ण)
◦ Example: Ignoring the doctor's warning was a foolish decision that worsened his condition.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Perceptive (सूक्ष्मदर्शी/परखने वाला): Quick to notice and understand — a synonym of sagacious, not an antonym.

 

• Option 2: Sensible (समझदार): Having or showing good sense — a synonym of sagacious, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Prudent (विवेकपूर्ण/समझदार): Acting with care and good judgment — a synonym of sagacious, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• Synonyms of sagacious: wise, astute, shrewd, perceptive, judicious.

 

• Synonyms of foolish: silly, senseless, unwise, imprudent, stupid.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Ominous (अशुभ): Auspicious (शुभ), Promising (आशाजनक)

2. Pragmatic (व्यावहारिक): Idealistic (आदर्शवादी), Impractical (अव्यावहारिक)

3. Reclusive (एकांतप्रिय): Sociable (मिलनसार), Gregarious (मिलनसार)

4. Sordid (घृणित/नीच): Honorable (सम्माननीय), Noble (उदात्त)

5. Taciturn (मितभाषी): Talkative (बातूनी), Loquacious (बातूनी)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Felicity."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. Misery.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Felicity" means intense happiness or bliss. (परम सुख/आनंद)

 

• "Misery" means great unhappiness or suffering, and figuratively a condition of deep wretchedness. It is therefore the correct antonym. (दुख/कष्ट)
◦ Example: Years of poverty and illness had reduced the family to utter misery.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Rapture (अपार हर्ष) — a synonym meaning intense pleasure or joy, not an antonym of felicity.

 

• Option 2: Elation (उल्लास) — a synonym meaning great happiness or exhilaration, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Ecstasy (अत्यानंद/उन्माद) — a synonym meaning overwhelming joy, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of felicity: sorrow, distress, wretchedness, anguish, affliction.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Unruly (अनियंत्रित): Obedient (आज्ञाकारी), Disciplined (अनुशासित)

2. Vigilant (सतर्क): Careless (लापरवाह), Negligent (लापरवाह)

3. Wicked (दुष्ट): Virtuous (सदाचारी), Righteous (धर्मनिष्ठ)

4. Yielding (झुकने वाला/लचीला): Stubborn (जिद्दी), Unyielding (अटल)

5. Adamant (अड़ियल): Flexible (लचीला), Compliant (आज्ञाकारी)

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "repudiate".
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. Accept.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Repudiate" means to refuse to accept or comply with something, or to reject its validity. (अस्वीकार करना/नकारना)
◦ Example: The minister publicly repudiated the rumours about his resignation.

 

• "Accept" means to agree to receive, believe, or undertake something, and is therefore the correct antonym. (स्वीकार करना)
◦ Example: After much persuasion, she finally accepted the committee's proposal.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 2: Reject (अस्वीकार करना): To refuse to accept — a synonym of repudiate, not an antonym.

 

• Option 3: Renounce (त्याग देना): To formally give up or reject — a synonym of repudiate, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Disavow (अस्वीकार करना/इनकार करना): To deny responsibility for or connection with — a synonym of repudiate, not an antonym.

 

NOTE

 

• The related noun is repudiation (अस्वीकृति/परित्याग), meaning the act of refusing to accept something.

 

• Synonyms of repudiate: reject, deny, renounce, disown, disavow.

 

• Synonyms of accept: agree, approve, embrace, acknowledge, receive.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Candor (स्पष्टवादिता): Deceit (छल), Duplicity (दोहरापन)

2. Docile (विनम्र/सीधा): Unruly (अनियंत्रित), Rebellious (विद्रोही)

3. Enervate (कमजोर करना): Invigorate (स्फूर्तिदायक बनाना), Strengthen (मजबूत करना)

4. Fervent (उत्कट/जोशीला): Apathetic (उदासीन), Half-hearted (अधूरे मन से)

5. Garrulous (बातूनी): Reticent (मितभाषी), Taciturn (मितभाषी)

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of "Credulous."
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Skeptical.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

 

• "Credulous" means having too great a readiness to believe things without sufficient evidence. (भोला/जल्दी विश्वास कर लेने वाला)

 

• "Skeptical" means not easily convinced and inclined to doubt claims, and figuratively questions things rather than accepting them at face value. It is therefore the correct antonym. (संशयवादी/शंकालु)
◦ Example: The scientist remained skeptical of the claim until it was backed by solid evidence.

 

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

 

• Option 1: Gullible (भोला/आसानी से धोखा खाने वाला) — a synonym meaning easily deceived, not an antonym of credulous.

 

• Option 3: Naive (भोला/अनुभवहीन) — a synonym meaning lacking worldly experience and too trusting, not an antonym.

 

• Option 4: Trusting (भरोसा करने वाला) — a synonym meaning tending to believe others readily, not an antonym.

 

• Other antonyms of credulous: doubtful, distrustful, incredulous, suspicious, wary.

 

5 Important Antonyms

1. Humble (विनम्र): Arrogant (घमंडी), Proud (अभिमानी)

2. Indolent (आलसी): Diligent (मेहनती), Industrious (परिश्रमी)

3. Jocular (विनोदी): Serious (गंभीर), Solemn (गंभीर/गंभीरतापूर्ण)

4. Kindle (जलाना/प्रज्वलित करना): Extinguish (बुझाना), Douse (बुझा देना)

5. Lavish (अत्यधिक/फिजूलखर्च): Frugal (मितव्ययी), Sparing (कम खर्च करने वाला)
